question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The family was saved from the burning building by the __brave__ firefighter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **fearless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"brave"** means having or showing courage. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the danger, the brave soldier went ahead to rescue his comrades.
 
 
 
• **"fearless"** refers to someone who shows a lack of fear; they are bold and courageous. (निर्भीक)
 
 
• **Example: **The fearless explorer ventured into the uncharted territory without hesitation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'brave'** is **'fearless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **fearless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unafraid** (निडर): Not feeling fear.

 
 
• **Example:** She was unafraid to speak her mind in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Timid** (डरपोक): Showing a lack of courage or confidence.
 
 
• **Example: **The timid child hid behind his mother during the thunderstorm.
 
 
 
• **Cowardly** (कायर): Lacking courage; excessively afraid of danger or pain.
 
 
• **Example:** His cowardly behavior during the crisis disappointed everyone.
